Class CliodynamicsEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier2.theories.CliodynamicsEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class CliodynamicsEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Cliodynamics Engine (Peter Turchin Secular Cycles & Structural-Demographic Theory). Simulates: 1. Asabiyyah (Social Cohesion / Solidarity Dynamics via coupled differential equations) 2. Elite Overproduction & Intra-Elite Competition 3. Continuous Political Instability Index (PSI) 4. Continuous Civil Strife Mortality ($\mu_{\text{strife}} = \mu_0 \cdot \Psi^2$) 5. Continuous Peripheral Border Defection via Distance-Decay of Imperial Power ($\Psi > \mathcal{C}_{\text{state}}$).
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3

Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • STRIFE_MORTALITY_COEFF_PER_YEAR

      public static final double STRIFE_MORTALITY_COEFF_PER_YEAR
      Characteristic annual civil strife mortality coefficient (Turchin & Nefedov 2009; Turchin 2016). At peak instability ($\Psi = 1.0$), excess mortality is $\sim 1.5\%$ per year across afflicted populations.
